Question

Wording 1: survey years 2019, 2021, 2023

Total number of weeks worked at any job since last interview date. Note: In the year the youth turned 14, this variable includes the weeks worked at an employee-type job starting from the month after the respondent's 14th birthday; in the year the youth turned 18, this variable includes any weeks self-employed starting from January of that year.
